answers.goal: Does not endorse the LLM switch yet; attributes the failed answers to a stage, measures retrieval apart (recall at the k sent, labelled queries including unanswerable ones, relevance pooled across retrievers), then generation on fixed contexts.
weakest: It compares whole pipelines end to end. It never measures retrieval on its own, with recall at the 5 chunks sent, gold-labelled queries including unanswerable ones, and relevance pooled across retrievers. It also never tests generation on fixed contexts.

answers.goal: Refuses to confirm the swap without a re-run; adds questions whose answer is in no document with a plain "not found" as expected answer; treats the swap as a release compared on the same questions, per class, after judging newly surfaced passages.
weakest: It never adds unanswerable questions whose expected answer is a plain 'not found', and it never judges sections the new model newly surfaces; it scores only against the single pre-labelled section, and its 3-point per-language threshold on roughly 40 questions each is within noise.
